questions.question: In a test series, South Africa defeated England twice, Bangladesh defeated South Africa twice, England defeated Bangladesh twice, South Africa defeated Pakistan twice and Bangladesh defeated Pakistan twice. Which country lost the highest number of times?

Total losses for each team = Sum of all matches lost by each team

⇒ Losses of England = 2

2. South Africa lost to Bangladesh twice.

⇒ Losses of South Africa = 2

3. Bangladesh lost to England twice.

⇒ Losses of Bangladesh = 2

⇒ Losses of Pakistan = 4

**Pakistan lost the highest number of times.**

questions.question: Two cyclists start from the same place and go in opposite directions. One goes towards the north at the speed of 14 Km/h and the other goes towards the south at 21 Km/h. How long do they take to be 43.75 Km apart?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

**Relative Speed** in opposite directions = Sum of individual speeds.

Relative Speed = 14 + 21 = 35 km/h.

Time = Distance ÷ Speed = 43.75 ÷ 35 = 1.25 hours.

Convert to minutes: 1.25 × 60 = 75 min.

**∴ The correct answer is 75 min.**

**Given:**

Speed of **Cyclist 1** (North) = 14 km/h

Speed of **Cyclist 2** (South) = 21 km/h

⇒ Time required in hours = 43.75 ÷ 35

⇒ Time = 1.25 hours

⇒ Time in minutes = 1.25 × 60

⇒ Time = 75 minutes

**∴ The correct answer is 75 min.**

Relative Speed Concepts

When two objects move in **opposite directions**, relative speed is the **sum** of their speeds (u + v). When they move in the **same direction**, it is the **difference** (u − v).

• English was to continue as the associate official language of the Indian government alongside Hindi for a transitional period of 15 years.
 
 
 
• This provision was included to provide a gradual shift from English to Hindi as the sole official language of the Indian government.
 
• The intention behind the provision was to give sufficient time for the transition and promote the use of Hindi as the official language of communication and administration in India.
 
• During this period, both English and Hindi were used for official purposes, ensuring continuity and facilitating effective governance.
 
• Subsequently, in 1965, the Official Languages Act was enacted to further regulate the use of languages for official purposes. It provided for the continued use of English alongside Hindi for official functions of the central government, even after the initial 15-year period.
 
• Since then, the use of English as an associate official language has been extended through subsequent resolutions and acts, ensuring its continued usage for official purposes at the central government level.
 
• It's important to note that while Hindi and English are the two official languages of the central government, the Constitution also recognizes the use of regional languages in different states and Union territories of India, respecting the linguistic diversity and cultural heritage of the country.

questions.question: Sumanth bought a microwave oven at 15% less than its original price. He sold it at a profit of 35% on the price he had bought it for. By what percentage sales price set by Sumanth is more than the original price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Sumanth bought a microwave oven at 15% less than its original price

He sold at 35% profit on the buying price.

**Calculation:**

Let the original price = ₹100

Sumanth bought at 15% less = ₹85

He sold at 35% profit on buying price.

Selling price = ₹85 + 35% of ₹85 = ₹114.75

Difference between selling and original price = ₹114.75 - ₹100 = ₹14.75

Percentage increase = (₹14.75 / ₹100) × 100 = 14.75%

**∴ The selling price is 14.75% more than the original price.**

• A **writ of mandamus** is a court order that directs a government official, public body, or lower court to perform a duty they are legally obligated to carry out.
 
• It **ensures that public authorities fulfil their statutory duties**.
 
• This writ is typically used when a public official or body has failed to perform their duties or has refused to act, leading to an unjust situation.
 
• Key points about **mandamus**:
 
 
• It can be issued to enforce the performance of public duties by public authorities.
 
• It cannot be issued to compel an authority to act in a particular way if discretion is involved.
 
• Mandamus cannot be used if there is an alternative remedy available, or if the duty is not clearly defined by law.
 
 
 
• For example, if a government agency refuses to issue a license or certificate that someone is legally entitled to, the court can issue a writ of mandamus ordering the agency to issue it.
 
• However, it cannot compel the official to act in a way that involves personal judgment or discretion.
 
• This writ ensures the legal accountability of public bodies and is an important tool for upholding the rule of law.

questions.question: 10 points are placed uniformly along the perimeter of a circle. Let A and B be two points among these such that they are the end points of a diameter. If a triangle formed using three of these points is chosen at random, what is the probability that it will lie completely on one side of AB, the points A and B being included?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total ways to choose 3 points out of 10 = ¹⁰C₃ = 120.

Since A and B are diametrically opposite, there are (10 − 2) ÷ 2 = 4 points on each side of **AB**.

A triangle lies on one side including A and B if it uses A, B, and 1 point from either side.

Favorable cases = 1 point from side 1 OR 1 point from side 2 = 4 + 4 = 8.

Probability = 8 ÷ 120 = 1 ÷ 15.

**∴ The correct answer is 1/15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total points **n = 10**. A and B are **diametrically opposite** points.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cafa2163bd4615e87550228c65373e9aef95140628df3a11f4237f92ee1f581f.png] 

**Step 1: Calculate Total Outcomes**

⇒ Total ways to form a triangle using 3 points out of 10 = ¹⁰C₃

⇒ ¹⁰C₃ = (10 × 9 × 8) ÷ (3 × 2 × 1) = 120

**Step 2: Calculate Favorable Outcomes**

⇒ For a triangle to lie completely on one side of **AB** while **including points A and B**, the third point must be chosen from the remaining points on either side.

⇒ Number of points excluding A and B = 10 − 2 = 8 points.

⇒ Since points are uniform and AB is a diameter, there are 8 ÷ 2 = 4 points on each side of the line AB.

⇒ A triangle including A and B must take the form {A, B, Pᵢ}.

⇒ Favorable points = 4 (on side 1) + 4 (on side 2) = 8.

**Step 3: Calculate Probability**

⇒ Probability P(E) = Favorable Outcomes ÷ Total Outcomes

⇒ P(E) = 8 ÷ 120 = 1 ÷ 15

**∴ The correct answer is 1/15.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Combinations Formula

The number of ways to choose r items from n is ⁿCᵣ = n! ÷ [r!(n − r)!].

Right-Angled Triangle Property

Any triangle formed by the endpoints of a **diameter** and any other point on the circle is a **right-angled triangle**.

Probability Definition

Probability of an event is the ratio of the number of favorable outcomes to the total number of equally likely outcomes.</p

B : H :: P : V :: N : ?

Hence, the correct answer is** "T".**

questions.question: There are six persons i.e. A, B, C, D, E, F working in different offices i.e. K, L, M, N, O, P not necessarily in same order. There are three males and three females. B is the wife of E and is working in office N. None of the women works in L or P. C is the sister of D and is working in office K. F is working in office M. D is working in L. No man works in O. Who works in office P.
questions.solution:
According to the given information:

1) B is the wife of E and is working in office N.

 
• B (female) works in N.

2) None of the women works in L or P.

 
• Therefore, since B is a woman, she cannot work in L or P.
 
• Since C is also a female (sister of D), she cannot work in L or P either.

3) C is the sister of D and is working in office K.

 
• C (female) works in K.

4) F is working in office M.

 
• We don't yet know F's gender.

5) D is working in L.

 
• D (male) works in L.

6) No man works in O.

 
• Since D is male and works in L, the other males (E and F) must work in either M or P.

Now we have: 

we have:

 
• B (female) - N
 
• C (female) - K
 
• D (male) - L
 
• F - M
 
• E - either O or P (since he’s the husband of B)
 
• O cannot have males, so E must work in P.

Thus, F works in M and E works in P.

Now, since no man works in O, the only option left is for F to work in M and E to work in P.

So, the person who works in office P is E.

Hence, the correct answer is** "E".**
